title: Santal Rebellion
subtitle: A major armed uprising against exploitation and colonial authority in the Bengal Presidency.
summary: The Santal Rebellion of 1855-56 was an armed uprising against zamindars, moneylenders, police, and colonial structures. It became one of the most extensive adivasi resistance movements in the Bengal Presidency.
heroTagline: A major armed uprising against exploitation and colonial authority in the Bengal Presidency.
whyItMatters: It broadens the timeline beyond elite politics by foregrounding adivasi armed resistance.
